title: Evaluation of a combined circuit
statement: For any number $n$ of variables, any Boolean gate type, any finite list $cs$ of Boolean circuit trees on those variables, and any assignment $x$ of Boolean values to the variables, combining $cs$ gives the same value as applying a gate of the chosen type directly to the list of circuits in $cs$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
$x$ is an assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ variables
